title: Canonical Support Case v1
description: One transformed support ticket for a CRM-shaped demo target. This identifier is a schema identity, not a promise of a hosted endpoint.

source_ticket_id.description: Source ticket reference; not a generated CRM case number.

organization_name.description: Display name of the organization associated with the ticket; not an account match.

reporter_first_name.description: Given name of the reporting contact.

reporter_last_name.description: Family name of the reporting contact.

reporter_email.description: Reporting contact email; syntax only, no deliverability lookup.

anyOf.description: Reporting contact email; syntax only, no deliverability lookup.

created_at.description: Time the ticket was logged, normalized to UTC.

updated_at.description: Time of last source update, normalized to UTC when supplied.

anyOf.description: Time of last source update, normalized to UTC when supplied.

assignee_first_name.description: Given name of the support assignee, if supplied.

anyOf.description: Given name of the support assignee, if supplied.

assignee_last_name.description: Family name of the support assignee, if supplied.

anyOf.description: Family name of the support assignee, if supplied.

priority.description: Normalized priority: P1 Critical, P2 High, P3 Medium, P4 Low.

affected_user_count.description: Number of users affected, when known.

anyOf.description: Number of users affected, when known.

engineering_ref.description: Source-provided engineering issue reference; no lookup or validity guarantee.

anyOf.description: Source-provided engineering issue reference; no lookup or validity guarantee.

comments.description: Optional preassembled conversation; wording and order preserved.

anyOf.description: Optional preassembled conversation; wording and order preserved.
